items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Louis always wanted somebody to sing, you know, sing things with him, because he had Velma over there as a foil, you know, and she -- they were fantastic team together.

ctx.x: I didn't do this originally with him. Jack Teagarden did them, 'Rockin' Chair', who was, incidentally, was a very

fine, a great musician. He did 'Rockin' Chair' originally with Louis, and Louis always wanted somebody to sing, you know, sing things with him, because he had Velma over there as a foil, you know, and she -- they were fantastic team together. Velma wasn't a great singer or nothing like that, but she certainly was the right foil for Louis. I would have hated to have followed them on stage, man.

But Louis kept me up all night, up until about 9:00 o'clock in the morning, showing Tyree how to do these spots with him that -- because how I really got to doing well was Louis helped me, you know. He'd say, now, when I get -- when I mug like this, you do that or you do this, and over the long period of time I worked with him, I picked up a lot of those little mannerisms to do with working with him.
